ADMIN V4.2.1 · CARD INTAKE

What's new

Everything below is new in this build. Sections run in the order you'll walk them.
1Create Purchase Order
  • Item Type dropdown
2Create Order — Admin
  • Item category
  • Order Type — Pre‑Graded or Raw, cards or coins
  • Auto‑attach PO Number
  • Auto‑attach Purchase Order ID
  • Priority selection
  • Order appears on the PO page when linked to a PO
3Process Page
  • Load 10 and Load 12 buttons for speed
4Scan App EXTERNAL TO ADMIN

Phone at the scan station, prototyped here so it can be walked end to end. Images go to cloud storage — admin picks them up when the box is scanned on the order.

5Order Detail Page
  • Upload Images — scan the box to pull the scans in
  • Synced receipt printer — print one label or all
  • Printing labels kicks off ML grading
6ML Grading

Machine takes the first pass at every subgrade — the team validates. New pages:

Purchase Orders

Demo path — bringing a purchase order in
  1. Click Create Purchase Order, pick a vendor, fill the starred fields, then Create.
  2. The Edit Purchase Order screen opens. Click + Create Order and fill Order Type, Category, Quantity and Cost.
  3. The order lands in the table below with an Orders #. Click Open in Orders on that row — or go to Orders in the top nav and search the number — to process and box it.

Process

Demo path — the intake queue
  1. Click Process on any row to open its Submit Order screen.
  2. Orders with a card count above zero have cards to verify; the arenaclub rows are empty on purpose.
  3. Verified orders leave this queue and move on to boxing.

Demo path — verifying the cards
  1. Check each card, adding a note in any row if needed.
  2. Flip Verify All at the bottom, or toggle rows one at a time.
  3. Click Verify Order — it blocks until every card is verified.
  4. Start Capture turns on your webcam for the intake recording.

Orders

Demo path — process, verify, box
  1. Type 2602 in Order # to find the sample order.
  2. Click Process Order to open the Submit Order screen.
  3. Flip Verify All, then click Verify Order.
  4. Boxing opens: scan the bin, scan the box, load the cards, store the box, then Done.
  5. Watch this row change from Inbound → Pending Boxing → Pending Scan.
  6. Click SCAN on the row — the phone scan app opens: scan the box, set the card count, shoot both sides, then COMPLETE BOX.

Order

Demo path — images, labels, grading
  1. Coming from the scan app, click VIEW on the order to land here. The Front, Back and Label columns are still empty — capturing on the floor is not the same as the files being here.
  2. Click ↑ Upload Images top right. In the Scan Last Box panel, hit the green correct box button — the front and back scans drop into the table.
  3. The Label column stays empty on purpose: the label is generated by grading, not by the scanner.
  4. Pick a printer, then click Print All. That kicks off ML grading — watch the progress bar run through crop, corners, edges, centering and surface.
  5. When grading finishes the labels appear in the table and the cards move to Pending Review.
  6. Open a card with the blue Review button, or click its 8AC number in the table, to see the subgrades and adjust them.

Demo path — grading one card
  1. Work the Tasks table down the page: crop, card type, corners, edges, centering, surface, then review.

Create Purchase Order

What to fill in
  1. Click Select Vendor and pick one from the list.
  2. Set Item Type — pick Cards to run the card flow.
  3. Type a Transaction Amount.
  4. QuickBooks and Invoice links are optional for this demo.

Edit Purchase Order

Purchase Order

Demo path — create the order on this PO
  1. Click + Create Order top right.
  2. Select Item Category (e.g. Cards), then Order Type: Submit and Vault.
  3. Set Raw Qty to 1 — that one raw card runs the full grading demo.
  4. Enter a Purchase Cost. Everything after that is optional.
  5. Click Create Order.
  6. The order appears below with an Orders # — click Open in Orders to process and box it.
Orders on this PO
ActionOrder Orders #Purchase Order ID TypeCategory QtyCost PriorityStatus
Where this order goes next: it appears on the Orders page under its Orders #. From there: Process Order → verify → Box Order → box it → Scan → grading.

Create New Order

For the demo
  1. Select Item Category — e.g. Cards, Watches
  2. Order Type: Submit and Vault
  3. Cards or Coins: set Raw Qty to 1. Anything else: Quantity
  4. Enter a Purchase Cost
  5. The rest is optional — click Create Order
